meaning: The mainline reads the master-state byte at (#4e00) and branches on it — the cabinet's whole attract/ready/play/dying/level-clear/game-over lifecycle is dispatched from this one byte. This is the ROM analogue of src/core/phase.ts's advancePhase (the pure MAINLINE dispatch). #4e00 is read at several mainline sites (0195/01ad/01c6/032d/03c8); this claim pins the first, canonical read.

A master-state transition: the mainline WRITES the new state into byte (#4e00) with `ld (#4e00),a`. One of the three state-write sites (0984/269a/318c) — the ROM analogue of advancePhase returning a new GamePhase. This claim pins the 0984 write.
A master-state transition: `ld (#4e00),a` stores a new lifecycle state into #4e00. The second of the three state-write sites (0984/269a/318c). ROM analogue of a GamePhase transition in advancePhase.
A master-state transition: `ld (#4e00),a` stores a new lifecycle state into #4e00. The third of the three state-write sites (0984/269a/318c). ROM analogue of a GamePhase transition in advancePhase.
